title: Smooth principal localization: the localized conormal sequence of a presentation is split exact
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $I\subseteq P$ an ideal and $A=P/I$; the conormal module $I/I^2$ is an $A$-module. Let $\mathrm d:I/I^2\to\bigoplus_{i=1}^nA\,\mathrm dx_i$ (the free $A$-module on symbols $\mathrm dx_1,\dots,\mathrm dx_n$) be the $A$-linear map $\mathrm d(g\bmod I^2)=\sum_{i=1}^n\overline{\partial g/\partial x_i}\,\mathrm dx_i$, with $\partial/\partial x_i$ the formal partial derivatives [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative] and the bar the image in $A$. Let $a\in A$ be such that the localization $A_a$ is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and let $\mathrm d_a:(I/I^2)_a\to\bigoplus_{i=1}^nA_a\,\mathrm dx_i$ be the localization of $\mathrm d$ at $a$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Then (1) $\mathrm d_a$ has an $A_a$-linear left inverse (in particular it is injective); (2) the $A_a$-linear map $\pi:\bigoplus_{i=1}^nA_a\,\mathrm dx_i\to\Omega_{A_a/R}$, $\mathrm dx_i\mapsto\mathrm d(\bar x_i/1)$ ($\Omega_{A_a/R}$ and its derivation as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]), is surjective with kernel the image of $\mathrm d_a$. Hence $0\to(I/I^2)_a\xrightarrow{\mathrm d_a}\bigoplus_{i=1}^nA_a\,\mathrm dx_i\xrightarrow{\pi}\Omega_{A_a/R}\to0$ is a split short exact sequence and $(I/I^2)_a\oplus\Omega_{A_a/R}\cong A_a^{\oplus n}$ as $A_a$-modules.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07EZ (lemma-compare-standard), part (e), first sentence ('By assumption we have a short exact sequence 0 -> (I/I^2)_a -> (+) A_a dx_i -> Omega_{A_a/R} -> 0 which is split exact'); the same argument in the proof of Lemma Tag 07C6 (lemma-find-strictly-standard, lines 160-170). It rests on Algebra, Lemma Tag 00S1 (lemma-NL-homotopy: the naive cotangent complex of any presentation is homotopy equivalent to NL_{A/R}), Lemma Tag 00S7 (lemma-localize-NL), Lemma Tag 08JZ (lemma-principal-localization-NL) and Definition Tag 00T2 (definition-smooth)
